question: Which of the following dynasties ruled from Thaneshwar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushyabhuti.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Pushyabhuti dynasty **also known as the **Vardhana dynasty** ruled parts of northern India **during the 6th and 7th centuries.**
 
• The Pushyabhuti Dynasty (c. 500 CE - 647 CE) rose after the downfall of the Gupta Empire (3rd century CE - 6th century CE) in the 6th century CE in northern India.
 
• The core area of their kingdom was situated in what is now the state of Haryana in India with the capital at Sthanishvara or Thaneshwar.
 
• The dynasty reached its zenith under its last ruler **Harsha Vardhana. **He ruled from 606 AD to 647 AD.
 
• The capital of Harshavardhana's Empire was Kannuaj. 
 
• His empire covered much of **north and north-western India.**
 
• His Empire extended from Punjab to northern Orissa and **from the Himalayas** to the** bank of the Narmada River.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maurya**__

 __
 
• Three important rulers of the Maurya dynasty were
 
 
• **Chandragupta.**
 
• **Bindusara.**
 
• **Ashoka.**
 
 
 
• Chandragupta dethroned the last Nanda ruler Dhanananda and occupied the **Patliputra** in 322 BC.
 
• Chandragupta Maurya was succeeded by his son Bindusara.
 
• Ashoka was the son of Bindusara. 
 
 
 
• Rashtrakutas__
 __
 
• They ruled **parts of South India** from the 8th to the 10th century CE.
 
• Their kingdom included the modern state of Karnataka in its entirety along with parts of the current Indian states of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Gujarat. 
 
• They were **originally known** to be the **feudatories of the Western Chalukyas of Vatapi.**
 
• **Dhantidurga** was the founder of the Rashtrakuta dynasty as he defeated Chalukyas of Badami.
 
• The **worship of Shiva **and **Vishnu** was **popular** during the Rashtrakuta reign.
 
 
 
• **Satavahana**__
 
 
• The Satavahana dynasty was an ancient Indian dynasty that was based in the Deccan region.
 
• They ruled between the 2nd century BCE and the early 3rd century CE.
 
• The capital cities of the dynasty were Amaravati and Pratishthana.
 
• Simuka was the founder of the dynasty.
 
• Pulumavi IV was the last ruler of the Satavahana kingdom.
